notes.title: Bug Fixes & Mystery Box Item
notes.notes: [h2]Small Update Patch Notes[/h2][p]Bungers...I’ve pushed a new update with bug fixes and a few new features.[/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mystery Box Item[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new collectible mystery box that grants a [b]one-time sniper bullet ability[/b]. Use it wisely![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Jump & Ability Input Spamming[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players needed to spam jump or ability keys to get consistent results. Inputs are now more responsive and reliable.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Rank Assignment for New Players[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where new players were incorrectly listed as [i]Unranked[/i]. They will now correctly start as [b]Poop 3[/b] as intended.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Main Menu Visual Glitch[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the ball could appear over the options menu in the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your attention to this pressing matter.[/p]

notes.title: BUNG BALL FOREVER
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171170/43f40b6328060fe5d3153c6236db4d86ac302964.png"][/img]BUNG BALL FOREVER: Major Update Patch Notes[/h1][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Networking upgrade:[/b] Now running on Photon Fusion 2 for smoother multiplayer and networked physics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Client-side prediction:[/b] Your moves feel more responsive, even with a bit of lag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ping counter:[/b] See your connection directly on the scoreboard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam integration:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Invite friends and join games easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Player names and ranks now link to Steam accounts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam Rich Presence so friends can see when you’re playing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Main menu & UI update:[/b] Cleaner, looks better, easier to navigate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New map:[/b] [i]Arizona[/i]! (Its a literal volcano)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map selection:[/b] Pick the next map at the end of the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loading screen & tips:[/b] VERY helpful info while waiting for the game to start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New ball model:[/b] A fresh look for the Bung Ball.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Changes / Ability Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Big Ball ability:[/b] Pushes players away if they’re too close when activated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gulag knockback:[/b] Players stuck in the gulag get more knockback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mine ability:[/b] Explosions are now more consistent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Waltuh ability:[/b] Less disorienting for players.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes / Improvements[/h3][p]Fixed issue where scores carried over between games and old data wasn’t cleared.[/p][p][/p][h2]SORRY FOR THE YEAR LONG WAIT![/h2][h2]THANK YOU FOR PLAYING!!!
[/h2][h3]KEEP BUNGING FOREVER[/h3][h3]     - Slap Chicken Games
[/h3]
